acceptanceCriteria: The prove report records application_revision and test_revision for every run and the test tree digest is identical across sides.
Fixture tests produce each ladder verdict, including REGRESSION_DETECTED, SCENARIO_BROKEN and NEW_REACH.
A base failure at a different location than the outcome assertion reads INCONCLUSIVE.
An empty expected value is refused with outcome-vacuous.
body: Expert panel 2026-10-17 (six read-only lenses, docs/build-log/2026-10-17-cce-expert-panel.md) on CCE-V0 (docs/specs/change-compiled-e2e-v0.md) toward the owner goal: compile the E2E test that checks a change, on demand, and eventually replace hosted suites. Verified: prove.go:356-368 stages the whole revision, so the base run executes base test code; controls are template-only BBF wrong-locator and wrong-expected-value; prove.go:586-593 returns FAILS_AT_HEAD before reading base. Per CCE-V0-017/018 and the amended CCE-V0-009: run the head scenario against the base application (record application_revision and test_revision), add omitted-event controls on the expecting step and each fixture setup, split FAILS_AT_HEAD into REGRESSION_DETECTED (base passes) and SCENARIO_BROKEN, add NEW_REACH for outcomes absent at base, require DISCRIMINATES to fail on value mismatch at the outcome's own assertion location, refuse empty expected values as outcome-vacuous, and report cleanup failure separately.
title: CCE prove: hold the test tree at head, add structure controls, split the verdict ladder
